ABVisualiser

class ABVisualiser(visualisation_dir: str, aggregation_method: str = 'median', save_visualisations: bool = True)[source]

Bases: object

The visualisations will include:

  • Graph structure plotting

  • Realtime model runtime display

  • Post-runtime summarisation graphs

  • Per-agent lifetime information

  • Per-graph lifetime information

Parameters:

  • visualisation_dir (str) – A path to a subdirectory to which all relevant visualisation outputs should be saved to.

  • aggregation_method (str, optional) – The method to use for aggregating parameters (i.e. “mean”, “median”, etc.).

  • save_visualisations (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the visualisation outputs should be saved.

Methods

graph_node_opinion

A helper function that takes in a GraphNode object (node payloads in the Graphs), and reports the string conversion of the agent's opinion in the GraphNode.

graph_node_values

A helper function that takes in a GraphNode object (node payloads in the Graphs), and reports the plotting information for the agent in the GraphNode.

visualise_hierarchy

A standalone function to visualise the graph for a specific social hierarchy within the ABModel.

visualise_hierarchy_mpl

DEPRECATED This function was originally used when mpl_draw() was the graph plotting function in use.

visualiser_iteration

Visualise the radicalisation of agents across the entire agent population; called from the parent model's iterate function at every model iteration.

visualiser_iteration_mpl

DEPRECATED This function was originally used when mpl_draw() was the graph plotting function in use.
